planned_by: Claude (Critic): gap review R12-1/R27-1/R44-1 — event bus module never wired
goal:
T40 — live updates: wire the existing event bus into an SSE endpoint and use it in Mission Control.

services/api/evoforge/event_bus_and_sse.py has DomainEventBus and MissionControlSSEGateway (tested, never called from
main.py). Use them (or a thin adapter over them):
1. main.py: publish a small event whenever a mission is created/advanced/cancelled and when an eval job changes status:
   {seq (monotonic int), type ("mission.created"|"mission.advanced"|"mission.cancelled"|"eval_job.updated"),
   mission_id / job_id, state/status, ts}. Never include code, diffs, tests, prompts or secrets.
2. GET /v1/stream?after=<seq>&limit=<n, default 100, max 500>&wait=<seconds, default 25, max 25>: text/event-stream
   frames "id: <seq>
data: <json>

" for events with seq > after, in order; returns early once `limit` frames were
   sent, otherwise keeps the connection open up to `wait` seconds for new events, then closes (clients reconnect with
   Last-Event-ID / after). wait=0 returns immediately with the backlog.
3. Web: apps/web/lib/proxyPolicy.ts (+ cases) allow GET /v1/stream; the proxy route streams upstream.body through with
   content-type text/event-stream (no buffering) for that path; Mission Control (apps/web/app/[locale]/page.tsx) opens
   an EventSource on /api/evoforge/v1/stream and refreshes on events, falling back to the existing polling when the
   stream errors.
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t40.py.
